'''Efridge Engelhardt Post-Coruscant Naboo Celebration''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Efridge Engelhardt]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18074">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18074 Post-Coruscant Naboo Celebration], DeckTech (Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt, 4 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18074/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18074/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Efridge Engelhardt]]
* '''Published:''' 4 August 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Post-Coruscant Naboo Celebration''

* '''Strategy:''' The galactin senate, enough said...

== Original post ==

'''Post-Coruscant Naboo Celebration'''
* '''Author:''' Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt
* '''Published:''' August 4, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' The galactin senate, enough said...

=== Strategy ===

I just wanted to post this and see how you guys liked it. i think it has potential and most of the low destiny stuff can be pulled out. im gonna work on the air stuff some, let me know what you think
